answer: Memory-hard PoW gates entry: each new node runs a RAM-bound proof priced by its own memory, so each fake spends its own watts. A farm spinning N clones pays N separate evaluations plus N times genuine work. No sharing or parallel: each lane runs live on its own hardware, borrowing a node's memory fails. Skipping the proof fails attestation; forged keys slashed. Clusters sharing keys forfeit bonded capital plus 12-epoch forfeiture, lose vouching rights. Like a summit where frost crystals break to the horizon, cost compounds per identity, never shared, in a cipher only the wind knows.
